title: Kuldra Easy Farm Guide – Level 9 Armour & Weapons  | RuneScape Dragonwilds
author: OER Games
description:
In this video I show you the easiest way to farm Kuldra, the final boss in RuneScape: Dragonwilds, for all the Level 9 armour and weapons.
After killing him once I decided to farm the chest loot. The dungeon is long and time-consuming, so I found a fast method using 3 deaths to spawn much closer to Kuldra each run. During the fight I also discovered a bug that lets you carry the orb into the next phase, which speeds the fight up a lot and makes it much easier.
I did the whole farm on Easy mode to make it even faster. It took me around 12 hours to get the full set of Level 9 armour and weapons.
Hope this helps you get the gear without the long grinds!
If you have any questions or need any help, leave a comment below and I’ll reply.

#RuneScapeDragonwilds #Kuldra #Dragonwilds
